hypothesis_H_colloc.statement: In vlm.lattice the bound vortex of each panel joins the quarter-chord points of the two STRIP-EDGE chords (c0, c1), but the collocation point uses the chord at the strip MIDPOINT (cm). On a curved outline cm differs from the edge-chord average by delta ~ curvature x (strip width)^2, independent of nc, while the chordwise panel length is chord/nc. The collocation point therefore moves by delta relative to its own panel, a fraction delta*nc/chord of the panel that grows with nc: chord refinement at fixed ns diverges about linearly, span refinement converges, and a straight-edged planform (rectangle: delta = 0) is unaffected. At a polygon kink inside a strip delta is O(strip width), which would also make span refinement irregular on the fin outlines.
hypothesis_H_colloc.source_lines: vlm.py lattice(): cm = chord_at(poly_uw, 0.5 * (ue[i] + ue[i + 1])); C.append(to3(um, w(cm, f0 + colloc * (f1 - f0)))) against A/B from w(c0, fq), w(c1, fq).

Only C changes; A, B, N (normals as built), area and the solve are the unchanged vlm.py code.

controls.invariance_rectangle: A3 repaired must equal A3 core at every (ns, nc) within 1e-12 relative (delta = 0 there). If not, the repair changes more than the collocation inconsistency and D_colloc is invalid.
controls.N2_negative: N2 repaired must still be irregular in at least one family (a chord step is not cured by moving collocation points). If not, D_colloc is unknown.

prediction_and_decision.D_colloc: supported if A1, A2 repaired are regular in BOTH families and the controls hold; refuted if either A1 or A2 repaired chord family is still irregular; otherwise unknown.
prediction_and_decision.D_fins_after_repair: reported per arm (F1, F2, F3 repaired verdicts by family). If F1 and F2 repaired are regular, the fin irregularity is explained by H_colloc; if their chord families become regular but a span family stays irregular, the remainder is attributed to outline sampling (kinks), labelled as an inference; if their chord families stay irregular, H_colloc does not explain the fins.
